primarySourcesReviewed.provenance: Three-page original and four-page official Review are organizer/Japanese committee distributions. December2019/March2020 author supplement is separate. Parsed official formulas are incomplete; neither visual inspection nor full official formula transcription is claimed. independent-analysis is appropriate.

proofReview.prefixState: For subtree interval[lo,hi), S_v(t)=opt(lo,t). Prefixes before root keep the left state; at root cost=fullLeftOpt+h. For t>v, choosing left givesF=fullLeftOpt+(t-v+1)h and choosing right givesG=(v-lo+1)h+rightPrefixOpt(t). If left empty,F is root venue; otherwise root venue cost>=F. These cover all venues even with ties/empty children.
proofReview.singleCross: Extending a right prefix can add one participant at its old optimal venue at cost<=h. Thus rightOpt(t+1)-rightOpt(t)<=h and F-G is globally nondecreasing, including piece boundaries. An entire piece withF<=G at its last integer is removable; in the first piece withF>G at the end, binary search first strict-positive difference, retaining a nonempty suffix.
proofReview.globalMapInvariant: Processed frontier subtrees have disjoint coordinate intervals. Each live subtree has nonempty, disjoint, gap-free pieces over its own interval, all interpreted with the same cohort offset. Evaluations are inside an existing child prefix. Erase/cut/normalization loops stay within current child bounds; center key is unprocessed and unique. node_handle shifts a partial suffix key strictly before its next key, preserving ordering without const_cast.
proofReview.queryLifetimeAndTie: Original RMQ uses(height,originalIndex) once. Both Cartesian orientations compare original indices on equal heights, so mapped original peak is identical. A query suffix[v+1,R] is inside the right child and starts at its left boundary. Query is attached to that child and evaluated before its parent destroys its state. Root venue is covered by empty-side case or dominated by a side optimum. [2,1,2] returns5, not6.
proofReview.amortization: At most two pieces are born per vertex (center and F), each associated with that vertex. Full erasure kills a piece forever; at most one surviving suffix key cut per merge. Center/newF belong conceptually to leftSubtree+root. Normalize pieces of the smaller ORIGINAL vertex mass, regardless surviving fragment count. A surviving birth vertex joins mass at least twice the prior smaller mass, so each birth is adjustedO(logN) times. Contiguous map scans cost traversed pieces plus logarithmic range lookup; cuts/inserts/binary crossings costO(logN) per node. Together with RMQ/query reads, both passes totalO((N+Q)log(N+1)).
proofReview.integerSafety: After size/endpoint checks all indices/base products fit32bit int (2base<=2097152). Every cost<=NHmax<=7.5e14. Offset induction: choose oldleft offset or oldright offset+(leftMass+root)*h, hence<=newOriginalMass*Hmax. Stored start value is actual cost minus cohort offset; slope0..Hmax. Evaluations and normalizations fit the claimed conservative absolute3NHmax<=2.25e15 bound. LLmax is only minimized and never added.
proofReview.spaceAndDepth: Map has<=N nonempty disjoint live fragments. Per pass:6N ints andN long longs,2Q ints andQ long longs, plus map nodes; public peak/answer and input are additional linear storage. Original RMQ is scoped and freed before passes; passes are sequential. Cartesian construction and reverse parent-before-child processing are vector-based, including750000-deep chains. std::map has logarithmic internal height. OverallO(N+Q) storage.
proofReview.api: All original inputs included. Explicit extensions:Q0 and repeated pairs. Validates every height even forQ0, sizes before int casts, all endpoints before endpoint+1/indexing. Inputs are const and unchanged; no external grader symbol dependency. All temporary state is local and allocation exceptions unwind; independent calls after invalid calls/repeated calls have no stale map/query/cohort state.

reproducedActualFenceChecker.smallOracle: Every venue, every participant, every intervening height literally scanned; independent running-max outward scan crosschecked.
reproducedActualFenceChecker.orientedScope: Each direction checked separately forN<=7 so min cannot mask one incorrect direction.
reproducedActualFenceChecker.maximumScope: Each of seven750000-query cases has unique R, hence original distinct-query condition. Constant/monotone/alternating/hierarchical/arbitrary-random/binary-random cases. Constant case attains7.5e14. Complete-checker RSS includes independent oracles/expected arrays, not a claim of portable API byte payload.
